# BarStyle

> **File:** `config/BarStyle.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Reader for the BarStyle section: how every bar draws its widgets, accents and shadow, unless it overrides a group of them (Bar.enrichBarConfig)

### Properties

- `values` (readonly var): The section's values by key, as a bar's own would be
- `shadowed` (readonly bool): Whether surfaces cast the shadow
